page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 72 dedicated virtual CPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers between cloud resources.

The ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for enterprise-scale workloads. The absence of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff, making it less suitable for local-disk-intensive databases or machine learning acceleration. However, the high vCPU count and balanced memory allocation make it efficient for multi-threaded applications, web serving, application servers, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring substantial compute capacity without specialized hardware.
